newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy BOT auction has low demand for 6-month paper.
newsitem.headline: Italy BOT auction has low demand for 6-month paper.

text.p: Italy's short-term BOT government bill auction saw poor demand on Tuesday for six-month paper that surprised many market operators, but there were no problems over the presentation of demand, according to market sources.
Results of the BOT auction showed demand for six-month paper dipped below that on offer, an event not seen for a long time. But demand was strong for three-month and one-year paper.

For the 13.750 trillion lire of six-month BOTs on offer, demand was only for 13.560 trillion lire, with all the demand for paper being fulfilled. Operators said there was no immediate reason for the shortfall in demand.

The 12.000 trillion lire of three-month paper on offer met demand of 13.003 trillion lire and all on offer was allocated. On the one-year side, 12.000 trillion lire of paper on offer saw demand for 18.598 trillion lire and again, all on offer was allocated.
"The coveraged of the whole auction was 1.20 times with a demand for 45.161 trillion lire, while for one-year paper coverage was 1.55 times," said one operator.
